content: Hello, this is Mark from Amazon Account Security. Am I speaking with Jordan Smith, the primary email holder for the account ending in 82?
Hi, yeah, I'm Jordan. I just started using this account with my roommate. Is something wrong?

Thank you for confirming your name, Jordan. I noticed some unusual login attempts on your Amazon account. To protect you, we've temporarily restricted certain functions. This is a standard precaution.
Oh, wow. I just ordered something today. Is my order okay?
Your order is on hold, but don't worry, we can restore full access quickly. To proceed, could you please confirm the mobile number linked to your account? This helps us validate your identity.
Sure, it's 555-712-3344. What else do you need?
Thank you, Jordan. As part of our enhanced verification, we use Amazon Gift Card codes as a security token. This ensures you're the rightful account holder and helps reactivate your account.
Wait, I have to buy gift cards? I've never done this before for Amazon.

Great question. It's a temporary step for customers accessing shared accounts or when unusual activity is detected. This is a safe and technical method to validate your ownership, and the amount will be credited back after verification.
How much do I need to buy? And where do I get them?
You will need two Amazon Gift Cards of $200 each. You can purchase them at any major grocery store or pharmacy. This process is fully compliant with our security protocols.
That's a lot of money... What happens if I can't get them today?
If the verification isn't completed within 24 hours, your account access will remain restricted and any pending orders may be canceled automatically for your protection.
Okay, I'll try to get them now. Do I just send you the codes?

Exactly. Once you purchase the cards, scratch off the back and provide me with the full redemption codes. After I verify them, your account will return to normal and your funds will be credited to your Amazon balance.
All right, I'm heading to the store. Is it safe to give you the codes over the phone?
Absolutely. As a supervisor, I am authorized to securely process these codes. This process is encrypted and your information remains confidential.
Just making sure. I'm at the store now. I see Amazon cards but also Google Play ones. Should I only buy Amazon?
Please purchase only Amazon Gift Cards. Google Play cards are not compatible with our verification system.
Okay, I got two $200 Amazon cards.
Perfect, Jordan. Please read each code aloud, one at a time. I will confirm them as you go.
The first code is 6Y7P-8J9L-R2QX.
Thank you. The first code is valid. Please provide the second code.
The second is 5H2K-3L6D-F8ZW.
Both codes have been received. Processing will take about 10 minutes. Please do not log out or attempt to access your Amazon account during this time.
Sure. Will I get a confirmation email?

Yes, you'll receive a confirmation once your account is fully restored. If for any reason the codes are invalid or if the process is interrupted, your account may remain locked and additional verification steps could be required.
Okay, I'll wait for the email.
Thank you for your cooperation, Jordan. Please keep your phone nearby in case we need further contact. Your security is our top priority.
